entries.title: Jeremiah 10:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
1 The unequal comparison of God and idols. 17 The prophet exhorts to flee from the calamity to come. 19 He laments the spoil of the tabernacle by foolish pastors. 23 He makes an humble supplication.

A.M. 3397. B.C. 607. 2:4; 13:15-17; 22:2; 42:15; 1Ki 22:19; Ps 50:7; Isa 1:10; 28:14 Ho 4:1; Am 7:16; 1Th 2:13; Re 2:29
